name: James Jared Taylor
tagline: Painting, sculpture & a life in the arts
intro: An ongoing exploration of form, place, improvisation, and the space between painting and sculpture.
statement: I see no difference between them since they are derived from the same sources. The work simply becomes a brief record of action, improvisation, intent, combined with the constant impulse to build or construct in two or three-dimensional space.
about: James Jared Taylor is an American artist whose practice moves between painting and sculpture. Trained in sculpture and metal fabrication, he brings a construction-minded approach to images, materials, and space. After decades of living and teaching in Southern California, he relocated to Oregon in 2025, where he continues to work in both visual art and music.

education.school: Rutgers University, Mason Gross School of the Arts
